companyDescription: AI data-center semis · custom XPU silicon for hyperscalers, electro-optics and Ethernet · FY27 revenue guide ~$12B, FY28 target ~$18B
priceNote: Live $225.80 (-1.2%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $70.69-$329.88; ~15% below early-October levels and near the ~$216.62 post-Q2 low. Market cap ~$198B.
summary: Marvell guided Q3 FY27 to ~$3.15B revenue / ~$1.10 non-GAAP EPS, has FY27 at ~$12B and an FY28 target of ~$18B, and custom XPU revenue (doubled in FY26) is guided to double again in FY28. The stock has given back ~15% in the October AI-semis selloff to near its post-Q2 low. Consensus $341.44 (+51%; clears the gate). Self-check: at ~$198B this is large-cap, not mega; +20% just retraces to the ~$267 pre-Investor-Day level. earnings_beat has no tier-2 penalty. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +18% assumes a ~2-3 month horizon through the ~Dec 1 print. This pick's catalyst is ~36 days out, well outside the 14d North Star window, so a 14d backtest miss would be a measurement-horizon artifact. แนะนำ 5-10% ของ portfolio — Core Holding.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY27 earnings
catalysts.description: Expected ~Dec 1 (aggregator; Marvell historically reports in the first days of December). Company guided Q3 revenue ~$3.15B, non-GAAP EPS ~$1.10, gross margin ~53.4%. The read is custom-XPU ramp and FY28 ~$18B visibility.

risks: Sell-the-news pattern: fell 8-11.6% after a beat-and-raise in Aug 2026.
Customer concentration in a few hyperscalers' custom-silicon programs — a single program loss or delay hits the FY28 target.
~40x forward P/E leaves the multiple exposed to rate and AI-capex sentiment shocks.
Earnings date is an estimate (~Dec 1), not yet company-confirmed.
Competitive pressure in custom silicon (Broadcom, in-house hyperscaler teams).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Profitable AI-semis leader, but at ~40x forward earnings it re-rates with real yields and AI-capex sentiment (October's selloff hit it ~15%).
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.
